ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory risk-based customer due diligence under AMLD4/AMLD5 transposed into French law. Before incorporation, the registered agent and the SAS's designate representatives must screen all beneficial owners, directors, and signatories against the OFAC Specially Designated Nationals (SDN) list, UN Security Council Consolidated List, EU Consolidated Financial Sanctions List, TRACFIN guidance on politically exposed persons (PEPs), and the French FICHIER des comptes étrangers and national terrorism financing lists. Enhanced due diligence is mandatory for any PEP; source-of-funds documents, board authorization, and independent verification of identity are required. Continuous negative news and adverse media screening must be evidenced in the KYC file.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Formalités de création d'entreprise - Guichet Unique Entreprises (formalites.entreprises.gouv.fr) operated by the Institut National de la Propriété Industrielle (INPI)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: The SAS corporate name (dénomination sociale) may be written in any language using the Latin alphabet. All official corporate filings, articles of association, and commercial contracts must be in French; where the chosen name is in a non-Latin script, an official French transliteration must be submitted with the registration dossier.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Upon a name rejection by the Greffe, the applicant may (i) amend the corporate name and resubmit the incorporation dossier through the Guichet Unique Entreprises portal within the same pre-incorporation file; (ii) file a formal objection (référé) before the presiding judge of the competent commercial court (tribunal de commerce) under Article L.123-6 of the French Commercial Code, within 15 days of the rejection notice; (iii) if the rejection is based on confusion with a pre-existing RCS registration, submit a written request for reconsideration with the registrar. Final registrars' decisions are appealable by way of recours en annulation to the commercial court. A completely new name availability search must be launched if the rejection is final and the name cannot be lawfully adopted.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Virtual office acceptance is permitted subject to strict legal conditions. An SAS may register its registered office (siège social) at a licensed domiciliation company (société de domiciliation) located in France, provided a written domiciliation contract is executed and the domiciliation address is capable of receiving official correspondence. The Commercial Code (Article L.123-11-2; Decree 84-406) requires that the domiciliation provider be an approved agent. For the hyper-casual mobile game publishing industry, there is no industry-specific license, and a virtual office is acceptable for incorporation. However, the SAS must maintain real economic management and control in France to preserve French corporate tax residency and substance; absence of any physical presence and actual staff increases the risk of administrative challenges under Article 209 B and the anti-abuse doctrine.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Quantified risk as low but not de minimis: less than 5% annual probability of unannounced physical inspection in the first year for a standard low-risk SAS. Risk increases to approximately 10-15% if only a virtual office is used with no measurable French substance, no appointed officers, or no active bank account. Inspections may be performed by tax authorities, URSSAF, or the commercial registration office.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: French Commercial Code (Code de commerce), Articles L. 227-1 to L. 227-20 (SAS); L. 210-1 to L. 210-10 (general company provisions); L. 225-1 et seq. (references for corporate governance where applicable); Executive Order (Décret) n° 2021-653 for dematerialized filings

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Direction Générale des Finances Publiques (DGFiP) - Portal: impots.gouv.fr
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: French entities obtain SIREN from INSEE and VAT ID (FR + SIREN) upon registration with DGFiP; foreign entities must appoint a fiscal representative and follow procedures for obtaining a French tax identification number under the Code Général des Impôts
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No check-the-box elections available; SAS entities are taxed at entity level. Limited options for specific regimes such as holding company taxation under Article 209 ter of the CGI.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Mandatory electronic invoicing (facturation électronique) for B2B transactions; real-time data reporting to tax authorities via PEPES for eligible sectors; digital time-stamping (horodatage) required for all invoices.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Exports of goods to non-EU countries qualify for 0% VAT rate; intra-EU supplies may qualify under reverse charge mechanism; digital services to non-EU customers may be subject to specific rules or reverse charge
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Bill of Lading or equivalent transport document
Inward Remittance Certificate or proof of payment for offshore services
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: Claims of fraudulent export zero-rating may result in penalties of up to 40% of the evaded VAT, interest charges, and retrospective application of full VAT liability with clawback of benefits.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Approval of annual accounts and filing of annual accounts with the Trade and Companies Register
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Company shareholders; filing through the one-stop business formalities portal and transmission to the competent Trade and Companies Register
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Accounts must generally be approved within six months after the financial year-end and filed within one month after approval, or within two months if filed electronically
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Court injunction and a civil fine generally of EUR 1,500, increased to EUR 3,000 for repeated non-compliance; persistent non-filing may lead to judicial measures or ex officio deregistration. France has no single automatic strike-off deadline for this default.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Corporate income tax return, Form 2065 and applicable accounting schedules
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: French Tax Administration (Direction générale des finances publiques)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: For a 31 December year-end, generally by the second business day after 1 May; for other year-ends, generally within three months after the financial year-end
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late-filing surcharge generally of 10% of tax due, plus late-payment interest generally of 0.20% per month; additional penalties may apply for inaccurate or fraudulent filings.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual VAT return, Form CA12, where the SAS is subject to the simplified VAT regime
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: French Tax Administration (Direction générale des finances publiques)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Generally within the filing period specified by the Tax Administration after the end of the annual accounting period; not applicable where the company uses the normal monthly or quarterly VAT regime
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late-filing surcharge generally of 10% of VAT due, plus late-payment interest generally of 0.20% per month; repeated non-compliance may result in loss of the simplified VAT regime.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Beneficial ownership information review and update
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: French Trade and Companies Register through the one-stop business formalities portal
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: France does not generally require a separate annual beneficial ownership confirmation. Information must be updated within 30 days after a reportable change and must be reviewed at least annually as an internal control
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to file or maintain accurate information may result in a court order, criminal penalties for responsible persons, and restrictions or consequences affecting the company's registration status.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: No annual commercial franchise or business licence renewal for ordinary mobile-game publishing activities
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Not applicable unless a sector-specific authorization or local activity requirement applies
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Not applicable to an ordinary SAS conducting mobile-game publishing without a regulated licence
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Not applicable; separate tax, employment, consumer, data-protection, and platform obligations remain applicable.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: A statutory auditor is generally mandatory when the SAS exceeds at least two of the following thresholds at the relevant assessment date: EUR 5 million balance-sheet total, EUR 10 million net annual turnover, and 50 average employees. Additional rules apply to parent companies, controlled entities, groups, and court-ordered appointments. Shareholders meeting the statutory holding threshold may also petition the court for an appointment.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: Individual statutory accounts generally use French GAAP issued by the Autorité des normes comptables. IFRS is generally relevant to consolidated accounts where legally applicable or elected; it does not replace French GAAP for ordinary individual SAS statutory accounts.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: There is no routine annual UBO confirmation filing solely because a new year begins. The company must conduct an annual internal verification and file an update within 30 days of any change in beneficial ownership, control, or required identification information.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Register of Directors and corporate officers
Minute Book and shareholder decision records
Beneficial Ownership Register or accessible beneficial ownership filing records

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: Typically USD 650-1,950 per year for a registered office and ordinary corporate secretarial support; France does not generally require a registered agent in the common-law sense
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: Typically USD 3,000-10,000 per year for a small SAS requiring a statutory auditor, depending on transaction volume, group structure, revenue, and reporting complexity

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: 15% on first €42,500 taxable profit for SMEs (turnover ≤ €50M); R&D tax credit (up to 30%); patent box regime

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Form 1204 (Déclaration de résultat) via impots.gouv.fr electronic filing
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: 3 months after fiscal year-end (extendable to 6 months)

field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Report French-source revenue; non-residents file for French branch/PE income
Incorporate TP adjustments and foreign tax credits

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: €125 per month delay (max €1,500); 0.2% monthly interest on unpaid tax

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 12.8% (0% under EU Parent-Subsidiary Directive for qualifying dividends)
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: Submit TRC and beneficial ownership certificate via impots.gouv.fr portal

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: France applies OECD-aligned ESR; requires demonstrated economic activities; non-compliance risks income recharacterization

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Deliberate understatement of profits via artificial TP or false declarations
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Criminal penalties up to 5 years imprisonment and fines up to €80 million or 80% of turnover
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Personal criminal liability, fines, and disqualification; veil piercing in fraud cases

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Non-submission of Local File when group turnover exceeds €50 million
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Administrative penalties €10,000–€100,000 per infraction; 50% penalty on adjustments
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Personal liability for penalties and potential criminal sanctions if intentional

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Failure to withhold/remit dividend WHT or apply treaty relief
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Fines €5,000–€100,000 per infraction; criminal prosecution for willful non-compliance
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Personal liability including fines and possible imprisonment for fraudulent acts
